truth.description: shouldInline now honors forceInline only when it is true and lets false fall through to the callback and the size limit, but its only producer, the html plugin, passes false for icon, apple-touch-icon and manifest links and never true, so the forced branch never runs and those links are no longer kept out of inlining, which turns a small favicon back into a data url in the built html.

distractions.why: The html and svg-fragment exclusions now run after the callback on purpose, as the user's explicit answer for a file is meant to win over every built-in rule except lib mode.
